chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari narrated from Kulayb al-Asadi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who is killed in a sacred month: what is his blood money? He said: "It is a full blood money and one-third."

key_terms.دِيَةٌ وَ ثُلُثٌ: one full blood money plus an additional one-third
key_terms.دِيَتُهُ: his blood money, the prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing
key_terms.شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ: a sacred month in which violations are treated with increased gravity

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for someone killed during a sacred month in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the blood money for a person killed during one of the sacred months. The Imam عليه السلام states that the compensation is increased to one full diyyah plus one-third, indicating the greater sanctity of bloodshed in sacred times.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5169 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Kulayb Al-Asadi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who is killed during a sacred month - what is his blood money (diyyah)?
Imam (as) said: "It is full blood money plus one-third."
